name: Woolloongabba Medical Centre
businessDescription: Woolloongabba Medical Centre provides general practice healthcare for individuals and families in Woolloongabba and Brisbane’s inner south. The practice supports everyday health needs, preventive healthcare, women’s and men’s health, children’s health, chronic disease care, mental health, vaccinations, skin checks, selected medical procedures and telehealth where clinically appropriate. Patients can access care seven days a week, with online booking and clear patient information about fees, access, quality and after-hours options.
